### Witnessing Heaven on the Horizon - The Crosswalk Devotional - May 9
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/witnessing-heaven-on-the-horizon-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Luke 16:23
Points:
- The rich man in torment could clearly see Lazarus experiencing comfort beside Abraham.
- Even in agony, the rich man clung to his pride, expecting Lazarus to serve him.
- Hell is an irreversible reality with no possibility of exit or second chances.
- Tormented by regret, the rich man desperately pleaded for a warning to be sent to his brothers.
- Earthly ease must not distract people from preparing for eternity through faith in Jesus.

### Day 52: Jesus Loosens Our Grip on Stuff
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/jesus/jesus-day-52-jesus-loosens-our-grip-on-stuff.html
Passage: Luke 16:19-31
Points:
- Outward wealth and social status frequently lead people to look down on others.
- The parable warns against indifference toward those suffering without basic necessities.
- Christ calls believers to faithful stewardship, recognizing that God owns all things.
- Relying on possessions robs people of true peace, gratitude, and healthy relationships.
- Spiritual maturity requires cultivating humility and being poor in spirit regardless of wealth.
